extraction_notes: Source PDF identity: DMN6140LQ, public Diodes Incorporated datasheet DS37996 Rev. 3-2, July 2023; supplied PDF SHA-256 dde94f961543229d9c1a7a54029cb47d058b86b466e51e11bc75dbddc6e9b435.
The supplied ordering variant DMN6140LQ-7 is the SOT23 package ordering code shown on p. 1; the datasheet electrical identity is DMN6140LQ.
All electrical-characteristic table values are specified at TA = 25 degC unless otherwise stated. RDS(ON), VGS(th), and other short-duration pulse values use Note 7 to minimize self-heating.
This is an N-channel device. All voltage and current signs are represented with N-channel positive magnitudes.
VGS(th) is published as minimum 1 V and maximum 3 V at VDS = VGS and ID = 250 uA; no typical table value is published, so threshold_typ is null.

The strict schema stores typical RDS(ON) values of 0.092 ohm at VGS = 10 V, ID = 1.8 A and 0.115 ohm at VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 1.3 A. The product summary on p. 1 separately publishes maximum values of 0.140 ohm and 0.170 ohm for those two conditions.
IDSS is published only as a maximum of 1 uA at VDS = 60 V, VGS = 0 V; no typical IDSS value is given and the strict schema has no IDSS field.

Ciss = 315 pF, Coss = 18 pF, and Crss = 16 pF are typical values at VDS = 40 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz. Dynamic characteristics are guaranteed by design and are not subject to production testing (Note 8).
The Figure 10 capacitance family is plotted on a logarithmic capacitance axis. Ciss, Coss, and Crss points were digitized separately with VDS in volts and capacitance converted from pF to F.
The datasheet publishes Rg = 0.65 ohm typical at VDS = 0 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz; the strict schema has no gate-resistance field.

The datasheet publishes VSD = 0.75 V typical and 1.0 V maximum at VGS = 0 V, IS = 0.45 A, plus tRR = 16.8 ns typical and QRR = 9.0 nC typical at IF = 1.8 A and di/dt = 100 A/us; only the typical VSD is representable in the strict schema.
Thermal data are published on p. 2: RthetaJC = 39 degC/W, RthetaJA = 183 degC/W steady state under Note 5 and 94 degC/W steady state under Note 6. The strict schema has no thermal fields.

Figure 2 contains transfer traces for TA = -55, 25, 85, 125, and 150 degC at VDS = 5 V; only the TA = 25 degC trace was extracted. Figure 1 output curves are typical curves at the datasheet default TA = 25 degC.
The gate-charge figure is a verification curve at VDS = 30 V and ID = 1.8 A. Table values include Qg = 8.6 nC at VGS = 10 V, Qg = 4.1 nC at VGS = 5 V, Qgs = 1.0 nC, and Qgd = 1.7 nC.
